body.message:
I understand, thank you.

However, since we have been living in this apartment for almost three years, there have been several different agents managing it, and there were a number of issues with the apartment from the very beginning. I have photos and videos documenting those issues.

For that reason, I would prefer to be present during the inspection. Could you please let me know a specific time for tomorrow’s check-out inspection? I would like to be there so that, if there are any questions, I can show you the photos and videos and we can discuss everything together.

I just want to make sure there is no misunderstanding and that nothing is deducted from the security deposit because of issues that already existed.
